basics.label: Product Manager | Revenue Cycle Management | Healthcare SaaS & RCM Platforms
basics.summary: Healthcare RCM product and solutions leader with 12+ years across U.S. medical billing, revenue-cycle operations, healthcare technology, business analysis, analytics, automation, implementation, and workflow transformation. Brings 7+ years of product-ownership-equivalent responsibility across founder-led RCM product and service design, solution architecture, roadmap thinking, requirements, backlog prioritization, UAT, and cross-functional delivery. Translates operational pain points and payer rules into clear priorities, user stories, business rules, acceptance criteria, scalable workflows, and measurable product outcomes.
